pictures.scene: Edward Lear, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the walled city lying gold across the valley in the morning light, for the choirmaster a Psalm of David a song, praise awaits You O God in Zion
pictures.name: pd_lear_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Fritz von Uhde, The Mealtime Prayer — the family standing with folded hands at the table before they eat, to You our vows will be fulfilled, O You who listen to prayer
pictures.name: pd_uhde_the_mealtime_prayer

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Woman Taken in Adultery — the accused kneeling in the light at the foot of the temple steps with the crowd pressing in, all people will come to You, when iniquities prevail against me
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_woman_taken_in_adultery

pictures.scene: Carl Bloch, Gethsemane — Christ kneeling under the rock with the angel bending over Him, You atone for our transgressions, blessed is the one You choose
pictures.name: pd_bloch_gethsemane

pictures.scene: Pieter de Hooch, The Courtyard of a House in Delft — the open door and the swept yard of a house someone is welcomed into, and bring near to dwell in Your courts, we are filled with the goodness of Your house
pictures.name: pd_de_hooch_courtyard_of_a_house_in_delft

pictures.scene: Karl Friedrich Schinkel, Medieval City with Cathedral — the great church standing under a rainbow with the procession coming out to it, the holiness of Your temple, with awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us
pictures.name: pd_schinkel_medieval_city_with_cathedral

pictures.scene: Edward Robert Hughes, The Light of the World — the lantern carried through the dark to the shut door, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth
pictures.name: pd_hughes_the_light_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Among the Sierra Nevada Mountains — the peaks standing over the lake with the light breaking through the cloud, and of the farthest seas, You formed the mountains by Your power
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_among_the_sierra_nevada

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — the boat driven up the wave with the disciples clinging on and Christ at the stern, having girded Yourself with might, You stilled the roaring of the seas
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, The Wave — the sea heaped up and breaking under a low black sky, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations
pictures.name: pd_courbet_the_wave

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Twilight in the Wilderness — the whole sky burning red over the empty country at the end of the day, those who live far away fear Your wonders, You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy
pictures.name: pd_church_twilight_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Robert S. Duncanson, Landscape with Rainbow — the rainbow standing over the watered valley with the cattle at the stream, You attend to the earth and water it, with abundance You enrich it
pictures.name: pd_duncanson_landscape_with_rainbow

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, Waterfall in a Rocky Landscape — the full stream pouring white over the rocks, the streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_waterfall_in_a_rocky_landscape

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Ploughed Fields (The Furrows) — the turned earth running in long furrows to the far wall, by providing for the earth, You soak its furrows and level its ridges
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_ploughed_fields_the_furrows

pictures.scene: Camille Pissarro, Orchard in Bloom, Louveciennes — the fruit trees all out in white blossom after the rain, You soften it with showers and bless its growth, You crown the year with Your bounty
pictures.name: pd_pissarro_orchard_in_bloom_louveciennes

pictures.scene: Meindert Hobbema, The Avenue at Middelharnis — the road running straight away between the tall trees to the village, and Your paths overflow with plenty, the pastures of the wilderness overflow
pictures.name: pd_hobbema_the_avenue_at_middelharnis

pictures.scene: Charles-Émile Jacque, Shepherdess and Sheep, Fontainebleau — the shepherdess leaning on her staff while the whole flock comes down to drink, the hills are robed with joy, the pastures are clothed with flocks
pictures.name: pd_jacque_shepherdess_and_sheep_fontainebleau

pictures.scene: John Constable, The Cornfield — the standing corn ripe in the valley beyond the lane with the flock coming down it, and the valleys are decked with grain, they shout in triumph
pictures.name: pd_constable_the_cornfield

pictures.scene: Jules Breton, The Song of the Lark — the girl standing still in the field with her sickle and her mouth open at the rising sun, indeed, they sing
pictures.name: pd_breton_the_song_of_the_lark

lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song.
Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion;
to You our vows will be fulfilled.
O You who listen to prayer,
all people will come to You.
When iniquities prevail against me,
You atone for our transgressions.
Blessed is the one You choose
and bring near to dwell in Your courts!
We are filled with the goodness of Your house,
the holiness of Your temple.
With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us,
O God of our salvation,
the hope of all the ends of the earth
and of the farthest seas.
You formed the mountains by Your power,
having girded Yourself with might.
You stilled the roaring of the seas,
the pounding of their waves,
and the tumult of the nations.
Those who live far away fear Your wonders;
You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
You attend to the earth and water it;
with abundance You enrich it.
The streams of God are full of water,
for You prepare our grain
by providing for the earth.
You soak its furrows and level its ridges;
You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
You crown the year with Your bounty,
and Your paths overflow with plenty.
The pastures of the wilderness overflow;
the hills are robed with joy.
The pastures are clothed with flocks,
and the valleys are decked with grain.
They shout in triumph;
indeed, they sing.
